name: Alpine Day Camp
operator_name: Greater New York Councils, Scouting America
description_short: Scouting run day camp on 500 wooded acres at Alpine Scout Camp along the Palisades, open to all children entering grades 1 to 7, Scouts or not. Groups rotate through climbing, hiking, an Olympic size pool, nature, sports, theater, crafts, target sports and outdoor skills.
notes: Pricing posted as 2026 rates, which the camp says it will honor for 2027 if a $70 deposit is placed before new rates come out: one week about $605 including the deposit and a $100 registration fee (waived for Scouts); multiple weeks $500 to $545 a week; full summer $487 a week. Drop off 8 to 9 am and pick up 5 to 6 pm are included. Shuttle routes from New Jersey and New York City cost extra (for example $210 a week from the Palisades Center lot; door to door $300 the first week, $200 after). Inspected under Scouting's National Camp Accreditation Program.
